name: Siteklean Website Scanner
author: MAHESH KUMMARA

sections.description:
It offers the following core features:

Features
1. Malware Detection:
– Scans your website for malicious code, scripts, and files.
– Identifies known malware patterns.

  1. WordPress Version Check:
    – Monitors your WordPress installation for outdated versions.
    – Encourages prompt updates to ensure compatibility and security.

  2. File Integrity Issues:
    – Compares your WordPress core files, themes, and plugins against their original versions.
    – Detects unauthorized changes, corrupted files, or tampering by malicious actors.
    – Highlights files that require immediate attention or restoration.

  3. Google Safe Browsing Status:
    – Checks if your website is flagged as unsafe by Google Safe Browsing.
    – Protects your site’s reputation by identifying issues that might lead to blacklisting.

User-Friendly Interface: Easy-to-use dashboard for both beginners and experienced WordPress users.

By integrating these powerful features, the SiteKlean plugin gives WordPress site owners peace of mind, ensuring their site remains secure, up-to-date, and trustworthy.

External services

This plugin connects to Google Safe Browsing API to check for security threats.

This plugin connects to third-party services:

– Google Safe Browsing API: Used for checking website safety.
– Data sent: Website URLs (for security scanning).
– API Used: Google Safe Browsing API (https://developers.google.com/safe-browsing/)
– Terms: https://policies.google.com/terms
– Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

– WordPress.org API: Used for version checks.
– Data sent: None.
– Terms: https://wordpress.org/about/privacy/
